description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse class, including immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructors.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntriesResponseTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior, immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and construction of RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse objects.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to ensure that RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse correctly implements equals and hashCode.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyEntries
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse with null PolicyEntries throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse with null JsonObject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that calling toJson on a RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse returns the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a RetrievePolicyEntriesResponse can be correctly instantiated from a valid JSON string and that its contents are as expected.
